candidate_inventory.stereochemistry_scope: stereo-unspecified source form; variants not pooled

definition.features: union of declared well rows and integer columns across all full replicates
definition.score_rule: mean of row-set Jaccard and column-set Jaccard; no replicate-count weighting

well_position_metadata_baseline.interpretation: The fixed row/column shortcut describes metadata-only label retrieval. Neither success nor failure establishes biological origin, artifact origin, or removal of all position/group confounding.

metadata_vs_rna_agreement.basis: primary exact four-label unique top1 only; secondary annotation matches are not used
metadata_vs_rna_agreement.prediction_bucket_rule: Unscoreable if either side is unscoreable; otherwise tied-top if either side ties; otherwise compare the two unique predicted labels.
metadata_vs_rna_agreement.interpretation: Paired descriptive agreement on the same twelve queries; neither overlap nor disagreement identifies biological or artifact origin, or separates all confounding.

metadata_sanity_scope: All exact/shared-group scores are zero by design; not a general metadata predictor.
wortmannin_stereochemistry: stereo-unspecified source form; variants not pooled
secondary_annotation_scope: Exact label matches plus LY-294002/wortmannin cross-predictions only; shared annotation does not establish RNA equivalence, mechanism, or biological correctness.
limits_ja: 陽性対照名を持つ固定BRDラベル4種類・12問い合わせの技術診断で、強い既知摂動を選んだ偏りがあります。
source構造と記載keyの内部整合だけを確認しました。wortmanninは立体未指定の報告形で、実物stockや外部の完全指定形との一致は未確認です。
同じBroad/L1000配布版内の検索です。metadataと解析法を見た後の診断で、盲検・独立施設の検証ではありません。
共有する測定群があり12件は独立した生物学的反復ではありません。20入替えも独立実験ではなく、p値・CI・普遍的合格閾値を計算しません。
LY-294002とwortmanninの共有PI3K注釈による副次一致は、生物学的な正解やRNAの同型性を意味しません。常にどちらかを選んでも副次一致は1/2で、取り違えは主4ラベル指標では失敗です。
成分と測定条件の影響を完全に分離していません。食品・治療効果、正常化、人体で届く量、タンパク質78条件との接続は未検証です。
前回のカフェイン／ケルセチンの実RNA3/6・入替え3/6は変更しません。
limits_en: A technical diagnostic of four fixed source BRD labels and twelve queries; selecting known positive controls creates selection bias.
Checks establish internal source-graph/reported-key consistency only. The wortmannin form is stereo-unspecified; physical stock and an external fully specified reference were not verified.
Retrieval is within one Broad/L1000 release, after metadata and methods were viewed. It is neither blinded nor independent-facility validation.

Queries share measurement groups and are not twelve independent biological replicates. Twenty gene permutations are not independent experiments; no p-values, confidence intervals or universal pass threshold are computed.

The shared PI3K annotation of LY-294002/wortmannin defines a secondary match only, not biological correctness or RNA equivalence. Always choosing either label already yields 1/2 secondary matches; swapping them remains a primary four-label error.
Compound and measurement-condition effects remain unresolved. Food/treatment effects, healthy-state restoration, human exposure and connection to the 78-condition protein catalog remain untested.
The earlier caffeine/quercetin result, observed 3/6 and fixed permutation 3/6, is unchanged.
